Subject: Evidence request: onboarding/offboarding + access recertification for SIG

Hi Irene,

As part of ACME Health's SIG submission and our SOC 2 evidence refresh, our security team needs a compact bundle showing your onboarding and offboarding controls for personnel who have accessed customer prod data over the last 12 months. Specifically we need: 

- A roster of completed security training (name, role, completion date) for the last 12 months (redacted PII ok).
- Confirmation of background checks performed for external contractors and full-time hires (we only require redacted proof and date ranges, not raw PII).
- Access recertification logs (who approved, date, and outcome) for systems with customer data.
- Deprovisioning timeline and evidence for last 6 notable leaver events (screenshots or logs acceptable).

Can you provide a single handoff bundle or tell me what items you can provide by next Tuesday (2026-11-24)? If anything needs an NDA/attestation callout, let me know.

Thanks — small packet will do, we just need to validate controls.

Susan Hale
Security Program Manager, ACME Health
security@acmehealth.com
